prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity comparison board with TWO complete desktop web error-page designs for the existing Daily web app.
Primary request: one cohesive proposal showing its 404 state ABOVE its 500 state. Render two wide desktop page viewports stacked vertically, each approximately 1440 by 760, separated only by a thin neutral horizontal line. Overall portrait board around 1440 by 1520. Both viewports edge to edge; no device, browser chrome, desk or presentation captions.
Established Daily identity: minimalist professional personal day planner, English UI, crisp Helvetica Neue / Swiss sans-serif typography. Palette is off-white #f7f8f5, deep navy #172d52, pale sage #c7d6b8, olive #587542, muted gray-green supporting text. Keep the professional calm feel and mature brand; avoid mascot, neon, gradients, glassmorphism, excessive decoration.
Header in each viewport: small navy "Daily" wordmark top left; at top right a small understated "Back to Daily" link. No extra navigation. Leave plentiful breathing room.
404 UI exact text: status "404"; headline "This page isn't on the plan."; description "We couldn't find this page. Let's get you back to Daily."; main olive button with white text "Back to Daily". No retry button for 404.
500 UI exact text: status "500"; headline "A small pause in your day."; description "Something went wrong on our side. Please try again."; main olive button with white text "Try again"; secondary quiet text link "Back to Daily". Never claim saved data or operating status.
Footer in each viewport: small muted "Daily" on left, "Privacy" and "Terms" on right. UI controls visibly recognizable and distinct; text legible, precise, no extra copy, no watermark.

Concept C — Papierowy poranek / A paper day planner.
Composition: CENTERED composition in each viewport, entirely unlike the left/right typography and geometry proposals. A small carefully art-directed tactile cut-paper sculpture sits ABOVE a centered short text block with small error number, headline, supporting copy, and action row. Overall generous whitespace. Mature editorial paper craft with subtle real paper grain and soft shallow cast shadows, using ONLY the Daily off-white, navy, sage and olive palette; no scene around it. 404 illustration: one small sage day-planner sheet with a clean rectangular off-white cutout and a loose matching navy paper tab beside it, quietly expressing a missing page; keep paper sheet completely free of letters, dates and numbers. 500 illustration: a pair of minimal vertical folded navy paper strips with one olive rounded paper arch, visually suggesting pause, in the same size and material as the 404 object. No characters, faces, animals, coffee cup, scenery, landscapes, scattered props or unrelated objects. Illustration occupies around 260 by 180 at a 1440 wide viewport, expressive but compact. Main centered headline navy around 40px, body around 18px, modest olive rectangular button with 7px radius. The illustration and typography are one balanced vertical group near the middle of the viewport. The footer and header remain simple real application UI.
